digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guards
propositions: A stale clone reaching sync._union_merge must return without merging when epochs mismatch, preserving both pre-operation refs exactly
A stale clone reaching push.py non-FF retry must abort the retry loop immediately (return, not break) when epochs mismatch, performing zero merges and zero re-pushes while leaving refs unchanged
The epoch value in .store-compat.json is a JSON string (ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix) compared only for byte equality; non-string values are treated as corrupt and trigger abort

The complete state matrix (9 rows: record and epoch independently absent/present/mismatched/corrupt/unreadable) must be enforced at both sync and push guard sites, with distinct error messages for remote-ref-unreadable versus file-absent
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) and local/remote tips must remain byte-for-byte unchanged
Behind clones with matching epochs must still converge via fast-forward, and strictly-ahead clones must return early, proving the guard placement does not wedge valid convergence paths
